definitions.gloss: price increase; raising prices; price hike
definitions.explanation: The act of increasing the price of goods, services, or wages.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}から{電気|でんき}{料金|りょうきん}が{値上|ねあ}げされる。
examples.english: Electricity rates will be raised starting next month.

examples.japanese: {原材料|げんざいりょう}の{高騰|こうとう}で{値上|ねあ}げせざるを{得|え}ない。
examples.english: Due to soaring raw material costs, we have no choice but to raise prices.

examples.japanese: {相次|あいつ}ぐ{値上|ねあ}げで{家計|かけい}が{苦|くる}しい。
examples.english: Successive price increases are straining our household budget.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{値|ね} (price, value) + {上|あ}げ (raising, from {上|あ}げる)

VERB FORM:
{値上|ねあ}げする - to raise prices (transitive suru-verb)
{値上|ねあ}げされる - prices are raised (passive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{値上|ねあ}げを{発表|はっぴょう}する - to announce a price increase
・{値上|ねあ}げに{踏|ふ}み{切|き}る - to decide on a price increase
・{値上|ねあ}げ{幅|はば} - amount of price increase
・{値上|ねあ}げラッシュ - wave of price increases

CONTEXTS:
・{物価|ぶっか}の{値上|ねあ}げ - price increases of goods
・{賃金|ちんぎん}の{値上|ねあ}げ - wage increase
・{家賃|やちん}の{値上|ねあ}げ - rent increase

ANTONYM:
・{値下|ねさ}げ - price reduction
